cipher.name: ConsonantVowelInterleaveCipher
cipher.idea: To balance high readability with robust obfuscation, this cipher processes text word-by-word. For each word, it groups all consonants together and all vowels together, then interleaves them starting with the first consonant, followed by the first vowel, second consonant, second vowel, and so on. Any leftover characters of the longer group are appended to the end of the word. Case is preserved. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged in their original positions.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
1. Split the text into words using spaces and punctuation as boundaries.
2. For each word, extract all consonants in their original order, and all vowels (a, e, i, o, u, A, E, I, O, U) in their original order.
3. Interleave them: take the 1st consonant, then the 1st vowel, then the 2nd consonant, then the 2nd vowel, etc.
4. If one group is longer than the other, append the remaining characters of the longer group to the end of the interleaved word.
5. Maintain the original case of each character.
6. Non-letter characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain in their exact original positions.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
1. Split the text into words using spaces and punctuation as boundaries.
2. For each word, separate the characters back into consonants and vowels by tracking their types in the interleaved order (the 1st character is a consonant, the 2nd is a vowel, the 3rd is a consonant, etc., up to the point where one group was exhausted and the rest are of the remaining type).
3. Reconstruct the original word by placing the consonants and vowels back into their original relative positions. (Since the original relative order of consonants among themselves and vowels among themselves is preserved, and the original word structure is deterministic, we can reconstruct the original word).
